mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as valuation models respond to lower cost of capital.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1150 thousand units signals weakening consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to reduced retail sales and corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1150.0 but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in labor force participation (PAYEMS < 147000) and retail sales (RSAFS < 490000) indicate broad-based economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS < 147000 and RSAFS < 490000 is met but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher cost of capital.
failure_condition: The trigger condition is met but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 index level indicates manufacturing sector contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate rising above 4.2% signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate hiring slowdown.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 4.2% but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

failure_condition: The joint condition of HOUST < 1150 and RSAFS < 490000 is met but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Labor market recovery (UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 147000) increases consumer spending power and corporate hiring, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through improved earnings outlook.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 147000 is met but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.
